jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator
Posted on 2 Nov 2026
Deadline on 29 Nov 2026

Description

Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, has been successfully providing software services since 2001 in global industry (USA, England, New Zealand, Asia and Africa). We have 280+ employees, with over 250+ skilled Software Engineers & SQA engineers. We continuously invest in hiring, developing, and retaining the best-in-class talents to leverage the latest technologies and offer the most advanced next-gen solutions to our clients. Some of our major projects and products include Nationwide Primary & Secondary Education ERP solutions for Bangladesh Government, Higher Education Management System running in 400+ US universities, Banking Compliance System running in 200+ financial institutions in the USA, 2021 BASIS National ICT Award winning ERP solution for container cargo management of private container yards. At DSi, we work to build state of the art next generation products with the industry's most talented resources.

We are seeking a highly organized and results-driven Project Coordinator to manage Government Software Projects from initiation to delivery. The ideal candidate will have a strong background & interest in software project management, excellent communication skills, and hands-on experience working with public sector clients, including ministries, government agencies, and state-owned enterprises is a plus.

Responsibilities

Project Management Support

Assist the Project Manager in planning, scheduling and tracking project activities against the contract milestones.
Maintain project trackers and logs for tasks, actions, issues and risks, and follow up with owners until items are closed.
Track due dates and alert the Project Manager before anything falls due.

Documentation and Reporting

Collect inputs from the team and compile them into periodic project reports to an agreed standard and format.
Draft official correspondence to the client and maintain an accurate record of what is sent and received.
Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes of internal and client meetings, circulate them and track decisions.
Maintain the project document repository, folder structure and version control.

Client and Stakeholder Coordination

Act as the day-to-day liaison with the client for scheduling, submissions and routine follow-up.
Coordinate training sessions, workshops and review meetings, including venue, materials, attendance sheets and certificates.
Follow up on pending client approvals, system access requests and clearance processes.

Governance and Compliance

Support project governance and review activities, and keep the project audit-ready.
Collect and organize evidence for internal and external quality, process and compliance reviews.
Ensure project documents follow the agreed house style, formats and templates.

Team Administration

Maintain the team roster, duty shifts and attendance records, and coordinate onboarding of new resources.
Coordinate access, workspace and logistics requirements for the on-site team.
Prepare presentations and status summaries for management and client briefings.
Requirements
2–4 years of experience in project coordination, project management support, business analysis or technical documentation, preferably on government or enterprise IT projects.
Strong written and spoken English and Bangla; able to draft formal correspondence to a government client without heavy editing.
Advanced MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with Google Workspace and document version control.
Proven ability to compile structured reports from multiple team inputs under deadline.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to follow up persistently without supervision.
Willing to work on site at client premises in Dhaka as the project requires.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience on a government ICT project, especially with a procuring entity, donor-funded programme or a ToR-driven contract.
Familiarity with project management tools (MS Project, Jira, ClickUp, Asana) and diagramming tools (Draw.io, Lucidchart, Visio).
Exposure to software delivery processes: SRS, UAT, release and change management.
Awareness of CMMI, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 documentation and evidence practices.
Project management training or certification (CAPM, PMP, PSM or CSM) is an advantage.
Eligible to obtain security clearance where a client project requires it.

Education Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Benefits
Dynamic and modern work environment
Attractive salary
In-campus free lunch, snacks
Two festival bonuses
Yearly increments
Healthcare coverage
Company paid training, courses and certification

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Engineer
Posted on 12 Nov 2026
Deadline on 29 Nov 2026

Description

Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi) has been working since 2001 as a Software Development Company globally. With offices in Bangladesh, USA and UK we have been providing high quality team augmentation and turn key project development services around the world.

We are looking for a Network Engineer who will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, monitoring, and maintenance of secure, scalable, and highly available network infrastructure supporting the project. The incumbent will ensure optimal network performance, security, reliability, and compliance with organizational and project requirements while supporting mission-critical operations.

Responsibilities
Design, deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure to support project operations.
Manage LAN, WAN, WLAN, SDN, and SD-WAN environments, ensuring optimal performance and availability.
Configure and administer routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VPN gateways, and other network security appliances.
Monitor network performance, capacity, utilization, and availability using appropriate monitoring and diagnostic tools.
Implement network security controls and ensure compliance with security policies, standards, and best practices.
Configure and manage routing and switching protocols, network segmentation, and secure remote access solutions.
Perform network troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.
Implement and maintain high-availability and redundancy mechanisms to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
Collaborate with cybersecurity, systems, database, application, and cloud teams to ensure seamless integration of infrastructure components.
Maintain network documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, operational procedures, and disaster recovery plans.
Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), vendors, and service providers for network-related services and support.
Participate in infrastructure planning, capacity management, risk assessment, and technology evaluation activities.
Requirements
Professional certifications (Minimum Professional Level such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIA, JNCIS-SEC, MTCRE, Fortinet NSE) are strongly preferred.
Proven expertise in designing, deploying, and managing large-scale network infrastructures.
Hands-on experience with SDN (Software-Defined Networking) and SD-WAN technologies.
Proficiency in networking protocols and services including TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, DHCP, VPN, 802.1X, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
Practical experience with routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and edge security appliances.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, including configuration and management of firewalls, IDS, IPS, and secure access controls.
Familiarity with network automation and scripting.
Experience with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
Strong ability to troubleshoot complex network issues.
Proven experience in maintaining secure, high-availability networks.
Excellent communication skills for collaboration with cross-functional teams and service providers.

10+ years in network administration with minimum 5 Years of Similar Nature Job Experience

British American Tobacco Bangladesh is hiring a Facilities Executive to support factory facilities, infrastructure and utilities, with a focus on reliable operations, safety, compliance and sustainability.

## Responsibilities

- Support the operation and maintenance of factory facilities, buildings, infrastructure and utilities to keep business operations running without interruption.
- Coordinate preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance for facility assets and services.
- Manage contractors and vendors, ensuring compliance with safety standards and Permit-to-Work (PTW) requirements.
- Monitor facility Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), maintenance costs and service delivery performance.
- Support water, compressed air, Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC), drainage, electrical distribution and fire protection systems.
- Ensure facilities meet statutory regulations, environmental requirements and company facility management standards.
- Coordinate workplace improvements, facility upgrades and infrastructure modifications.
- Maintain engineering documentation, facility drawings, maintenance records, compliance registers and service contracts.
- Support budgets, purchase requisitions, contractor invoices and payment certification.
- Inspect facilities and identify ways to improve reliability, performance and cost efficiency.
- Support emergency preparedness, business continuity planning and incident management.
- Advance energy efficiency, water conservation, waste reduction and resource optimization initiatives.

## Requirements

- You must hold a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Industrial Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- You must have 2 to 5 years of experience in facilities management, utilities operations, building services, engineering maintenance or manufacturing operations.
- You must have experience in a manufacturing, industrial or factory environment.
- You must understand HVAC, electrical distribution, water treatment, fire protection and compressed air systems.
- You must have experience managing contractors, vendors and service providers.
- You must be familiar with Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) standards and PTW processes.
- You must have strong analytical, problem-solving, planning, organizational, communication and stakeholder management skills.
- You must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (SAP PM), Industrial and Financial Systems (IFS) or Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) is an advantage.
- Exposure to Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) projects, sustainability initiatives and continuous improvement programs is preferred.

## Salary and benefits

- BAT offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package; no salary amount is specified.
- The role provides exposure to manufacturing and facility management practices within a globally recognized organization.
- Employees receive structured learning, career development and ongoing opportunities to strengthen professional and technical skills.
- The work includes hands-on involvement in utilities, infrastructure and engineering projects, CAPEX and facility improvements, and sustainability and resource-efficiency programs.
- BAT describes its workplace as collaborative and inclusive, welcoming people from diverse backgrounds.
- Its Global Returners program supports professionals restarting their careers after an extended break, including time spent on family care, parental leave, national service, a sabbatical or their own venture.

Junior Software Engineer

Nagorik Technologies is an AI-native enterprise technology company with 200+ in-house engineers building software, AI systems, cloud platforms and secure infrastructure for complex, business-critical operations. We have built, run, licensed and white-labeled our own products, so we own what happens after launch: reliability, security, scale and maintainability. Our work spans fintech, telecom, SaaS, healthcare, government and retail. We are ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 certified and an AWS Partner.

How we build software now

Our engineers use AI agents across the software lifecycle, from analysis and design to coding, testing and operations. Agents do not replace engineering judgment. They raise the bar for it, because an agent will confidently do exactly what a vague instruction allows. The skills that decide the result are:

Context: understanding the business problem, the existing system, the data and the constraints well enough to give an agent what it needs, and to know when its output is wrong
Specification: writing clear, testable specs and acceptance criteria that leave nothing to guess
Prompting: writing precise, structured instructions, examples and project rules for the task at hand
Loop engineering: designing the plan, act, verify and retry cycles an agent runs, including when it must stop and ask a human
Harness engineering: building the tools, permissions, sandboxes, tests, evaluations, hooks and CI gates that keep agent work inside safe, measurable limits
Verification and ownership: reviewing every change, proving it works, and being accountable in production

We measure engineers on outcomes shipped, defects avoided and systems that stay up, not on lines typed. A Claude certification is an advantage at every level.

The role

You will start your career learning how to work with AI agents properly, which is harder than it looks. An agent produces good work only when the engineer gives it the right context, a precise spec and a clear way to check the result. You will learn to do all three, and to understand every line you approve. You will be paired with a senior engineer who reviews your work and teaches you how production systems behave. You will also see far more real code, and far more real mistakes, than a traditional junior role allows.

What you'll do
Learn the business and the codebase behind each task before you start: read the requirements, the existing code, the data model and the related tickets
Turn well-scoped tickets into clear task specs and acceptance criteria that leave nothing to guess
Write prompts and project instructions using our templates, and see how small changes in context change the result
Work inside our agent loops and harness: run them, read where they fail and report why (missing context, vague spec, weak tests)
Write unit and integration tests, and use them to check generated code before it merges
Read, explain and question every change: why this query, why this structure, what could break
Fix bugs, trace issues through logs, and learn how our APIs, databases and queues fit together
Follow our security, review and release practices, and flag anything that looks unsafe
Document what you build and what you learned
What you bring
Bachelor's degree in CSE, EEE, IT or a related field, or equivalent proven skill
0 to 2 years of experience; strong fresh graduates and career changers with real projects are welcome
Solid grasp of the basics: OOP, data structures, SQL and relational databases, REST APIs
Working knowledge of at least one of PHP (Laravel), JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, NestJS, Next.js) or Python
Comfort with Git and pull request workflows
The ability to read code you did not write and explain what it does
Clear, structured writing: you can state a problem and its acceptance criteria in a few sentences
Curiosity and honesty: you ask when you do not understand, and you say so when generated code looks wrong
Advantages
A Claude certification or completed Claude coursework
Hands-on use of AI coding assistants on a personal, academic or open-source project, and a view on why they succeeded or failed
A project you built and deployed, even a small one
Basic Docker, Linux and cloud familiarity
What you will grow into

Within 12 to 18 months, you own small features end to end, write specs and prompts that produce reliable results, and review other people's pull requests with confidence. The path leads to Software Engineer.

What you get
Competitive salary based on skill and potential: [BDT range to be confirmed]
Two days weekly leave
Two festival bonuses
Yearly performance-based increment
Health insurance and wellness programs
Complimentary breakfast, lunch and evening snacks
Flexible working hours
A named mentor, structured onboarding and paid time to learn
How we hire

Short screening call, a practical task where you may use AI tools and must show your spec, your tests and your reasoning, then a conversation with the team. We care more about how you think and verify than what you memorized.
